Fixtures are synthetic, shaped from the upstream strongSwan 5.8.2 stroke formatter and the deployment-reported header and selector examples. No production output or partner identities were copied. The full fixture reconciles 51 established and 11 connecting IKE SAs. Incomplete variants are generated by tests.
Source: https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/blob/5.8.2/src/libcharon/plugins/stroke/stroke_list.c
